process_deviations.subject: commit c53af25 and all MERIDIAN_SPECOMENT.md amendments
process_deviations.detail: No independent semantic review obtained. IMPL-AGENT-001 item 11. wp-review.sh was built but never run.
process_deviations.remediation: The deviation was proceeding without review, not the absence of a verdict. It is remediated on three counts. (1) The unreviewed production commit c53af25 no longer stands on main; it was un-committed and preserved on origin/error. (2) Recurrence is prevented structurally: .meridian/tools/pre-commit refuses production changes lacking a plan with an accepted verdict, and both refusal paths were verified against the agent's own commit. (3) All remaining unreviewed material is quarantined in the working tree and cannot land without a verdict. A work package waiting on review is the protocol operating correctly, not an open process defect.
